text:
freya (Customer): Hey team — our app hit a bunch of client disconnects mid-stream while users switch from carrier -> home WiFi. Several sessions stopped at ~60% response and the client shows a plain socket close. Any ideas?
maya (Support): Sorry about that — can you share an example request id or a snippet of the client logs? Also roughly what device/network combo?
freya (Customer): Example request id: r-9a7c3b. Happened on Android 13, Pixel 6, while moving from 5G to a dual-band home AP. App keeps the SSE open but we see a TCP FIN then nothing. No rate limit errors.
mobile-qa: Repro steps we tried: enable hotspot on phone -> stream a 7k token response -> switch to home WiFi mid-stream -> client sees close, server shows partial bytes sent.
dylan (Eng): Thanks — two initial hypotheses: 1) client-side TCP reset during the network interface change (OS-level), 2) token/session TTL or auth revalidation triggered by reconnect that the client isn't doing. Do you have server-side connection close logs for r-9a7c3b?
freya (Customer): We have our logs but looking for clues from Redwood side — customer reported possible billing for partial output too (they were charged for tokens emitted before the disconnect).
maya (Support): Billing is based on tokens emitted — partial outputs should still be billed for tokens sent. We can check if any unusually short responses were billed incorrectly, but first we need to confirm the disconnect cause.
sam (SRE): Pulling proxy and edge logs for r-9a7c3b now. Meanwhile, can you try a client-side keepalive ping during the network handover? On Android the socket is often torn down when roaming between radios. A short-term mitigation is: send an app-level heartbeat every 15s and retry with resume tokens.
mobile-qa: We added a heartbeat and saw fewer occurrences, but still ~10% repro. Also noticed that when we retry immediately the server returns 401 if token TTL expired. The token expiry time was 30s.
dylan (Eng): That matches a TTL race. For streaming long responses we recommend tokens with longer TTLs or client refresh before the expected expiry. Also implement exponential backoff on reconnects and reattach logic: if server responds 401, refresh token and re-open stream, then send a resume hint (e.g., last-good-offset) to avoid re-generating entire output.
maya (Support): Could you paste the minimal client reconnect flow you used? small snippet helps.
mobile-qa: Sure — pseudocode: ```js
if (socket.readyState !== 1) connect();
socket.onclose = () => {
  // quick retry
  setTimeout(() => connect(), 200);
}
// headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
dylan (Eng): Two notes: 1) 200ms immediate retry can race with OS teardown; use jittered exponential backoff: 200ms -> 600ms -> 1.8s -> etc. 2) send a short POST to /v1/sessions/refresh or use your auth refresh flow before reconnect when token is near expiry.
freya (Customer): Any server-side config we can change? We can't ship a new client quickly for all users.
sam (SRE): On our side we can increase connection idle timeouts per-customer on the edge for a short window, and track TCP RST counts. I can enable extended keepalive for your tenant for 24h so you can gather repro metrics. Want me to do that?
freya (Customer): Yes please, that would help. Also can you flag the billing question — customer worried about being billed for partials that look like failures.
maya (Support): I'll open a billing ticket to review the invoice lines for that account and confirm charges. For the edge tweak, sam — please enable extended keepalive and enable debug logs for r-9a7c3b across the edge/proxy cluster.
sam (SRE): On it. Enabling keepalive and debug for that request id window now. Will report back with delta counts.
dylan (Eng): Follow-up engineering suggestions for long-term: 1) add resumable SSE semantics (client supplies last offset), 2) optional short-lived resume tokens so clients can reconnect before re-generation, 3) guidance doc on mobile handoffs — we'll draft and link here.
maya (Support): Great. freya, I'll coordinate the billing check + share the SRE debug output once sam posts it. For immediate mitigation try bumping token TTL to 2 minutes for a subset of users and roll out the heartbeat patch for the mobile app in next release.
freya (Customer): Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. We'll try the heartbeat patch on a canary group and report results.
oncall-bot: sam acknowledged the alert and attached edge debug: /mnt/logs/edge/2922223344-debug.tar.gz :thumbsup:
sam (SRE): Uploaded debug bundle and a short summary: increased keepalive reduced midstream closes from 18% -> 6% in our canary test. Full analysis incoming.
maya (Support): Closing loop: billing ticket opened (TICKET-8342), SRE debug uploaded, eng doc drafted to follow. Reopen if new patterns show up. :white_check_mark:
